items.title: Top Stock Reports for Berkshire Hathaway, Micron & Chevron
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway, Micron and Chevron headline today's top stock research reports, highlighting AI-driven demand, capital allocation and operational strength.

items.title: Cisco Falls 7% on Morgan Stanley Downgrade; Ciena Plunges 15%, Arista Networks Tumbles 10%
items.summary: Morgan Stanley just cooled on a stock that has beaten the market by a wide margin, and AI-heavy rivals are falling even harder. What does Cisco's own business mix reveal about why it bends while its peers break?

items.title: Nvidia Sinks 9% as Midterm Data-Center Fears Deepen AI Chip Rout: “Absolute Slaughter”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysNVIDIA fell 9% today as the post-midterm chip selloff deepened, and Everpure, Applied Digital and Ciena fell even harder. NVIDIA’s guidance already leaves out China data-center sales, so the new risk is slower US building and tougher AI rules.

items.title: Applied Optoelectronics Sinks 16%, Coherent Tumbles 14% Despite Strong Outlook, Lumentum Plunges 13% as AI Optical Stocks Slide
items.summary: Record revenue, raised guidance, and capacity sold out through 2027 couldn't save the optical group from a brutal two-day rout. One election result has traders dumping the whole supply chain, and the next catalysts could decide who recovers first.

items.title: Coherent Sinks 16% Despite $20 Billion Hyperscaler Deal as Democrats’ Midterm Wins Hit AI Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoherent fell 16% today despite a revenue beat, a raised outlook and a roughly $20 billion optics deal. Ciena and Credo Technology fell too, in an AI-stock selloff tied to Democrats’ midterm wins.

items.title: Ciena Is Up 58% in a Year. Its Next Report Has to Show Margins Can Keep Up
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCiena stock is up 58% in the past year, and its fiscal third-quarter revenue rose 37% to $1. 67 billion.
